input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The only convenience right (§6(a)) is available solely when no Statement of Work is outstanding, and the term under §2 runs indefinitely until terminated. As a result we have no ability to exit an active, open-ended time-and-materials engagement (which can readily exceed 12 months) other than for material breach, which fails the fallback (Customer termination on 60–90 days' notice). The redline adds a 30-day Company convenience right for the Agreement or any SOW, with payment only for Services performed and refund of prepaid fees, and confirms Contractor cannot walk away mid-engagement. We have left the mutual 15-day right in §6(a) intact: it operates only when no work is outstanding, so it does not let Contractor abandon a live engagement and it benefits us equally (noted rather than flagged).

proposal.summary: Add a Company right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice, with refund of prepaid fees and no termination fee, and confirm Contractor has no convenience right while an SOW is outstanding.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only allows convenience termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we would be locked into every engagement for its full duration. We have added our standard right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience on 30 days' notice, paying only for Services performed and recovering prepaid fees; if helpful we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) In addition to the foregoing, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Contractor, without any termination fee, penalty or other charge. Upon such termination, Company shall pay Contractor for Services properly performed through the effective date of termination, and Contractor shall refund to Company any prepaid fees for Services not performed as of that date. Contractor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience while any Statement of Work remains uncompleted.
